entities.summary: Jesse Bernard "Cab" Renick was an American basketball player who competed in the 1948 Summer Olympics. Renick was A 6'2" Guard for Marietta High School in Marietta, Oklahoma. He went on to star at Oklahoma A&M University. He was All-Missouri Valley Conference in 1939 and 1940 as well as an All-American in 1939 and 1940.
